judge.rationale: The candidate's implementation is functionally identical to the reference, renaming the `afterModelResponse` hook parameter to `totalUsage` and summing `UsageMetadata` fields across rounds via an `accumulateUsage` helper while properly handling `undefined` rounds. All acceptance criteria from the ticket are satisfied, including updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`, while leaving existing tests in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` untouched. Notably, the candidate tests a turn with two tool rounds (three provider calls) as literally requested by the first acceptance criterion, and adds unit tests for `accumulateUsage`. The only minor divergence from the reference is placing `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` rather than inline in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, and putting the new orchestrator tests into a separate `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file (plus leaving `.lore/dod.md`).
